description: Address v2 code review issues: fix randint panic on inverted range, extract duplicated unbox helpers to hostabi, and pre-allocate host functions in random package.
steps: Fix issue #1: Add guard in randintHost() and dynRandintHost() to return ErrEmptyRange when b < a
Fix issue #1: Add integration test for randint(5, 3) to verify error propagation
Fix issue #2: Extract unboxFloat, unboxInt, vmParamType to hostabi/unbox.go
Fix issue #2: Update math/math.go and random/random.go to use hostabi shared helpers
Fix issue #3: Pre-allocate host functions in random.New() and pass to emit closures
acceptance_criteria: randint(5, 3) returns ErrEmptyRange instead of panicking
unboxFloat, unboxInt, vmParamType exist only in hostabi/unbox.go
math/math.go and random/random.go import and use hostabi versions
random host functions are pre-allocated at New() time, not per emit call
findings: 1. All three review issues resolved in a single commit. 2. The shared hostabi.UnboxFloat/UnboxInt/VMParamType functions are exported (capitalized) to be usable cross-package. 3. choice() and shuffle() host functions still allocate per-emit because they depend on the argument's compile-time type (list element type varies); this is acceptable and matches the math module pattern for type-dependent hosts. 4. The user's preference for static types with dynamic support is preserved: static paths use pre-allocated typed host functions, dynamic paths use TypeRef with runtime unboxing.
